summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #416 by triaging, fixing, and replying to each thread.
summary.outcome: Fixed 2 valid issues (error-path leak in encrypt-worker service, misleading SDK doc comment), marked 1 batch-read comment as not applicable, committed and pushed. All 156 unit tests pass.

repo: The monorepo uses pnpm with typecheck and test scripts at the root.
integration.test.ts in the SDK contains live API tests requiring a running backend — these are expected to fail in isolation and are pre-existing failures, not regressions.
cipher-box has both a web app (apps/web) and an SDK package (packages/sdk).

code.finding: postMessage/getWorker can throw, leaving pending entries in the queue without cleanup — fixed by wrapping in try/catch and deleting the pending entry on error.
Doc comment overstated memory bounding guarantees — fixed as a doc-only change.
Batch upload reads all files into memory before the SDK call — this is an architectural pattern, not a bug, so the review comment was marked not applicable.

workflow: gh api graphql reviewThreads query is the correct way to fetch unresolved PR threads with isResolved status.
Replying to review threads requires REST (gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments) with --field in_reply_to as an integer, not -f.
Resolving threads requires GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread with the thread node ID.

friction: Pre-existing integration test failures (live API tests) show up in pnpm test output and must be manually verified as unrelated before proceeding — no clear way to skip them automatically.
open_items: useDropUpload.ts:140 batch-reads all files to memory before the SDK call — flagged by two reviewers as a potential memory issue; deferred as an architectural change rather than a bug fix.
Integration tests in packages/sdk/src/integration.test.ts require a running backend and are currently skipped/failing — should be gated or excluded from the default test run.
